reading.passage: Chinatown in San Francisco is the oldest in America. Each year it welcomes more visitors than even the famous bridge. People come for the food, the shops, and a real taste of Chinese culture.
reading.passageCn: 旧金山的唐人街是美国最古老的。它每年接待的游客比那座著名的大桥还多。人们为美食、店铺和地道的中国文化而来。

questions.q: What is special about this Chinatown?
opts: It is the oldest in America.
It is the newest in America.

questions.q: Why do people come to Chinatown?
opts: For the food, shops, and Chinese culture.

writing.prompt: Write a short introduction (3–4 sentences) to a culturally diverse place you know.
writing.promptCn: 写一段简短介绍(3-4句),介绍一个你知道的文化多元的地方。

lines.text: I'm going to Guizhou next month. Any places you'd recommend?
lines.cn: 我下个月要去贵州,你有什么推荐的地方吗?

lines.text: Definitely the ethnic minority villages. The culture there is so diverse.
lines.cn: 一定要去少数民族村寨,那里的文化非常多元。

lines.text: That sounds great. What can I see there?
lines.cn: 听起来很棒。我在那儿能看到什么?

lines.text: Traditional dances, old houses, and people playing the lusheng.
lines.cn: 传统舞蹈、古老的房子,还有人演奏芦笙。
